studies.title: Mortality characteristics in individuals with autism spectrum disorder across the lifespan: a narrative review.
studies.authors: Kılıç B, Ünal D, Aslan C et al.
studies.preview: This narrative review provides a comprehensive synthesis of mortality rates and associated risk factors among individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) across the lifespan. Following a search across PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar, 31 peer-reviewed studies were identified for synthesis.

studies.title: Autistic and non-autistic children's perceptual decision-making in visual orientation and motion tasks and the effect of task instructions.
studies.authors: Thomas L, Scerif G, Yusuf H et al.
studies.preview: Diffusion decision models (DDMs) offer the potential to go beyond standard accuracy and response-time indices to better understand perceptual decision-making in autism. One unanswered question is whether autistic participants can flexibly adjust the speed and accuracy of their decision-making according to task demands.
